label: TP
reason: The user-controlled input from the query string is decoded and directly used in the command execution via the 'bar' variable, which is then passed into the exec() call as part of the command arguments. This constitutes a command injection vulnerability where untrusted input can alter system behavior.

evidence.note: User input is extracted from query string, URL-decoded, stored in param, then placed into a HashMap and retrieved as bar, which becomes part of the command line argument array
The 'bar' value is directly included in the args array passed to Runtime.exec(), forming a command line injection vector
